d:
The OnePlus Pad 3 is a large, powerful Android tablet — but what’s it actually like to live with in 2026? After using it as my primary tablet for many months, I’ve got a pretty clear idea.
In this video, I focus on real-world experience — handling, display, software, performance, battery life, and gaming — to see where the OnePlus Pad 3 stands. It gets a lot right, especially with its massive 13.2” display and excellent software… but it’s not perfect.
